apps.name: Stuck on You
apps.tagline: An anonymous Valentine's message board with digital sticky notes on a shared corkboard.
apps.description: Stuck on You is an anonymous message board for the Valentine's season, offering a safe space to vent, confess feelings, or express gratitude through digital sticky notes on a shared corkboard wall.
apps.purpose: To give users a fun, anonymous way to share confessions, gratitude, and messages during Valentine's season.
apps.target: Students and community members wanting to send anonymous Valentine's messages.
apps.howItWorks: Write an anonymous note with a recipient, optional alias, and color, then submit it to a live corkboard that auto-cycles and supports manual pagination. Includes a LoveHue popup for discovering love languages.
apps.author: Iverene Grace M. Causapin & John Rey V. Bagunas

apps.name: Protect the Baby
apps.tagline: Draw underwater barriers to protect the baby from approaching sharks.
apps.description: Protect the Baby is a JavaScript game about defending a baby underwater. Players draw barriers that act as protective walls while sharks spawn from cages, creating an urgent, creative challenge to keep the baby safe.
apps.purpose: To provide a fun and creative drawing game where players solve quick defensive challenges by building underwater barriers.
apps.target: Players who enjoy casual browser games, drawing mechanics, and time-based challenges.
apps.howItWorks: Watch sharks emerge from underwater cages, then use a drawing tool to create barriers that block their path to the baby. Complete each arena by keeping the baby protected until the level is cleared.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales

apps.name: Review Well
apps.tagline: Review well po! Goodluck sa exams/quizes!
apps.description: Review Well is a cozy academic study-club platform where students upload lecture slides (PDF/PPTX), browse public reviewer materials, and keep everything in one personal library
apps.purpose: To make studying feel welcoming and manageable by giving students a cozy shared space to collect learning materials, discover helpful reviewers from peers, and build steady review habits together.
apps.target: Students who study from lecture slides and want an organized, shareable, low-friction review workflow — particularly study groups and classmates sharing course materials.
apps.howItWorks: Sign in with Google (or browse as a guest). Upload a PDF or PPTX to create a reviewer, set it public, unlisted, or private, and open it in the reading hub. Save guides you love, follow creators, and get notified of new reviews.
apps.author: Iverene Grace M. Causapin

apps.name: MC Skin Viewer
apps.tagline: View your Minecraft skin in 3D and download it as profile picture!
apps.description: MC Skin Viewer is a Minecraft skin viewer that allows users to view their Minecraft skin in 3D and download it to use it as their Minecraft profile picture.
apps.purpose: To provide a fun, accessible, and quick way to view and download Minecraft skins for profile pictures.
apps.target: Casual gamers, students, and anyone looking for a simple and accessible Minecraft skin viewer.
apps.howItWorks: Users can upload their Minecraft skin (PNG format) and view it in a 3D interactive viewer. They can rotate, zoom, and inspect their skin from all angles, and capture a screenshot of the skin to save it as their Minecraft profile picture.
apps.author: John Patrick Russel Lalo

apps.name: Flori
apps.tagline: A modern flower discovery and care application.
apps.description: Flori is a modern flower discovery and care application that helps users explore different flower species, learn how to care for them, and build their own digital flower collection. Designed with a clean and intuitive interface, Flori makes plant information accessible for beginners, hobbyists, and gardening enthusiasts alike.
apps.purpose: To make plant information accessible and help users explore, identify, and care for flowers through a clean, intuitive interface.
apps.target: Beginners, hobbyists, gardening enthusiasts, and anyone interested in learning about flowers and plant care.
apps.howItWorks: Browse a collection of flowers with beautiful imagery, search flowers by name, view detailed information and characteristics, learn proper watering, sunlight, and maintenance requirements, and save favorite flowers for quick access.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales

apps.name: Workflow
apps.description: Workflow is a unified CV Builder and Resume Analyzer that helps users create professional resumes and analyze them for ATS compatibility. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript, it offers a modern, intuitive interface for building, exporting, and optimizing resumes.
apps.purpose: To help users build professional resumes and analyze them for ATS compatibility with AI-powered insights.
apps.target: Job seekers, students, and professionals who want to create polished resumes and optimize them for applicant tracking systems.
apps.howItWorks: Use the CV Builder tab to fill in personal details, experience, education, and skills with drag-and-drop section reordering, then export as PDF or JSON. Use the Resume Analyzer tab to upload a PDF or DOCX resume, optionally paste a job description, and receive an ATS score, keyword analysis, and actionable recommendations.
apps.author: Jasper Rosales
